import cv2, numpy as np
im=cv2.imread('first_frame.png')[:,:,::-1]
# downsample and kmeans RGB+modest xy
s=cv2.resize(im,(320,180),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA).reshape(-1,3).astype(np.float32)
crit=(cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_EPS+cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_MAX_ITER,50,.2)
_,lab,cen=cv2.kmeans(s,12,None,crit,8,cv2.KMEANS_PP_CENTERS)
lab=lab[:,0]
for i,c in sorted(enumerate(cen),key=lambda x:-np.sum(lab==x[0])):
 ys,xs=np.where(lab.reshape(180,320)==i)
 print(i,'n',len(xs),'rgb',np.round(c).astype(int).tolist(),'bbox',[int(xs.min()*4),int(ys.min()*4),int((xs.max()+1)*4),int((ys.max()+1)*4)],'cent',[round(xs.mean()*4,1),round(ys.mean()*4,1)])
PY"
